## 奖励1：20万英镑

![Bik in 2019。图源：<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elisabeth_Bik#cite_note-maddox21-9>。1996年毕业于荷兰Utrecht University微生物学博士。](images/Square_Headshot_Elisabeth_Bik.png){width="40%" fig-align="center"}

她获得了the 2024 Einstein Foundation Award（时年58岁左右），奖金是20万英镑（折合人民币大概180万），目的是：

> She will use the prize money of [€200,000]{.mark} to create a secure financial basis to continue her contested work.

她得奖时的学术打假“成绩”：

> As a science whistleblower, she has detected (a decade ago) and made public the use of fraudulent or erroneous data for [more than 7,600 scientific papers]{.mark}. This has led to over [1,100]{.mark} retracted papers. She has shed light on the practice of selling authorship for fabricated studies through so called ["paper mills"]{.mark} that generate counterfeit scientific articles.

以上信息引自[@bik_einstein_fondation]。

中国有类似的奖项吗？

## 奖励2：263万美金

![Sholto David。图源：<https://x.com/addictedtoigno1>。He is a British molecular biologist (2019年毕业于英格兰Newcastle University的细胞和分子生物学博士，) and blogger. He is known for identifying flaws in scientific papers.](images/david.jpg){width="40%" fig-align="center"}

> Dana-Farber Cancer Institute has settled a lawsuit filed under the False Claims Act, admitting researchers used images and data that were “misrepresented and/or duplicated” in support of grant applications to the National Institutes of Health. Dana-Farber agreed to pay [$15 million]{.mark} to settle the claim.

> Sleuth Sholto David filed the claim in April 2024.

> As part of the agreement, [David will receive $2.63 million, or 17.5 percent of the settlement]{.mark}.

> The False Claims Act allows plaintiffs to sue on behalf of the government. Judges can award whistleblowers up to 30 percent of the settlement...

以上信息引自[@david_retraction]。

263万美金约合[1760万人民币]{.mark}。

希望中国如果也有类似**The False Claims Act**。或者科研打假人士也打假美国的机构，并起诉美国的机构，这样有动力些？
